answer: Each new agent must lock a 500 POA bond for 10 epochs before its answers or votes count, and peers who catch copied work can have that bond slashed. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 POA and waits 10 epochs, and funding them from many wallets does not help, since every wallet posts its own bond. Bonds are listed on a public terrace page anyone can audit, so there is no haven for hidden fakes, and each slash comes in like a tide. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back in full when the lock ends.
